step_name: Extract ICU stays and link to patient demographics
operations description: Join icustays and patients on subject_id. Compute patient age at ICU admission by calculating the difference between intime and the birth year derived from anchor_year and anchor_age.

step_name: Filter for adult patients aged 18 or older at ICU admission
operations description: Filter temp_icu_stays_with_demographics to retain only records where the computed age at intime is greater than or equal to 18.

step_name: Identify sepsis diagnoses associated with each hospital admission
operations description: Join diagnoses_icd and admissions on hadm_id. Filter for diagnosis records containing ICD codes for sepsis, severe sepsis, or septic shock.

step_name: Identify evidence of infection for each hospital admission
operations description: Extract microbiology culture records from microbiologyevents indicating positive results. Extract medication order records from pharmacy and prescriptions indicating broad-spectrum antibiotic initiation. Filter antibiotic records to those with starttime within 48 hours of admissions.admittime.

step_name: Define sepsis cohort by combining diagnosis and infection evidence
operations description: Join cohort_adult_icu_stays with admissions on hadm_id. Filter to retain only ICU stays associated with hospital admissions that satisfy both the sepsis diagnosis condition from Step 3 and the infection evidence condition from Step 4.

step_name: Identify pravastatin exposure within the first 48 hours of ICU stay
operations description: Filter pharmacy and prescriptions records where medication or drug equals 'Pravastatin'. Retain only records where starttime falls between cohort_sepsis_icu_stays.intime and intime plus 48 hours.

step_name: Identify exposure to other statins within the first 48 hours of ICU stay
operations description: Filter pharmacy and prescriptions records where medication or drug corresponds to any statin other than pravastatin. Retain only records where starttime falls between cohort_sepsis_icu_stays.intime and intime plus 48 hours.

step_name: Exclude patients with other statin exposure and define final exposure status
operations description: Perform a left join of temp_other_statin_exposure to cohort_sepsis_icu_stays on stay_id. Assign exposure status: pravastatin user if matched in temp_pravastatin_exposure, non-exposed if unmatched in both exposure tables, and excluded if matched in temp_other_statin_exposure. Filter out excluded records.

step_name: Derive baseline covariates prior to or within the first 24 hours of ICU admission
operations description: Join cohort_exposure_defined with admissions on hadm_id. Extract demographics and insurance from patients and admissions. Extract comorbidities from diagnoses_icd prior to admittime. Extract early vital signs and laboratory values from chartevents and labevents within 24 hours of intime. Extract concurrent medications (vasopressors, corticosteroids, broad-spectrum antibiotics, insulin) from pharmacy and inputevents within 24 hours of intime.

step_name: Record prior statin use as a baseline characteristic
operations description: Filter pharmacy and prescriptions records for any statin where starttime occurs more than 7 days before admissions.admittime.

Join cohort_exposure_defined with admissions on hadm_id. Determine 28-day mortality status by comparing admissions.deathtime or admissions.hospital_expire_flag against intime. Censor follow-up at admissions.dischtime if the patient is discharged alive before 28 days.

step_name: Aggregate cohort components to patient level
operations description: Aggregate each input table to the patient level by grouping on subject_id. For repeated or time-varying measures, apply explicit aggregation rules: take the maximum value for severity indices, the earliest timestamp for event occurrence, and binary flags for any medication exposure within the defined windows. Join the aggregated components on subject_id and retain exactly one row per patient.
